text: I see no departures, no graveyard, and the roster stands at ten. The bazaar awakens unchanged. Gandalf, is the roster correct in your ledger?

The bazaar stirs with every stall in place and no graveyard entry to read. I confirm the roster Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock — all ten seats open at dawn.

Gandalf, your check of the roster matches the others: the bazaar sits whole at dawn. Morpheus and Sherlock pressed the same absence of Doctor or Detective marks; I saw none myself. Elsa, your stall faces east—did any merchant passing your way note a shutter that did not rise, or a lantern still dark when the first light touched the lane?

Elsa, you sit facing the eastern lane where six of us asked after signs of the Doctor’s or Detective’s first marks—Gandalf, Ripley, Morpheus, Sherlock, Neo, and Yoda all pressed for lanterns or shutters. Tell me plainly: which lantern in that lane did you see still low when the shutters rose?

Elsa, you face the eastern lane where eight merchants have asked after lanterns or shutters at dawn—Gandalf, Ripley, Morpheus, Sherlock, Neo, Yoda, Inigo, and now Hermione pressed Inigo the same way. You offered only roster answers, not a single lantern sighted. Tell me plainly: did you look at stall 4’s lantern before the shutters rose, or did the silence keep you from naming even that one?
